title: Full risk register
headline: All ten risks in Table 6.6 have a likelihood, an impact, a numeric trigger and a response; four are rated High impact (risks 2, 6, 7 and 10).

columns.title: Table 6.6: ten risks (team judgement)
rows: Online share up over 2 points in a year; K4 not above Q1 baseline by Q3
Experience-led zones (P1); CENTRAL X as front door (D4)
Debt over 88% of GDP; BoT 2027 growth under 1.5%; R&S growth 4.3% or less
Amber/Red ladder; capped vouchers (R4); CPN already delays some residential launches
Arrivals down over 8% year to date (down 4.12% to 17 Oct 2026)
Line 6 in tranches; mix toward India, the Gulf and Europe (M2)
4. Bangkok saturation and tenant bargaining power
Renewal rule R1 (2–3% escalators, non-rent concessions first)
Intl. revenue under ฿720 million; Vietnam spend before a definitive agreement
No FY2027 Vietnam budget; Malaysia limited to the D5 pilot
Confirmed breach or leak; unreported in 72 hours; consent not live 31 Jan 2027
S1 set-up; aggregated extracts only; S4 survey ages 20+ only; count-only counters
Headroom to bond carbon path under 10% (18% in 2025); free space under 2.7%
Claims traced to CPN documents (K7); bond never said to fund the ฿110bn plan
Opening over a quarter late; finance cost over ฿4,149m; net debt/equity >0.60x
Launch spend follows CPN confirmation (D1); model rerun at every release
Reported minus core net margin over 1.5 points (3.2 in FY2025)
F1 on reported and core margin (K8); no credit for FX gains or CPNREIT sublease
Gen Z visits per active member under +5% at G3; Q4 gain under 3.1 points
Format zones (P1); creator briefs tied to CENTRAL X; move money to best format

columns.title: Scales and terms
columns.text: Likelihood: High above 50%, Medium 20% to 50%, Low below 20%. Impact: High if FY2027E net profit would move by more than 5% (฿1,022 million of ฿20,430 million) or an objective would be out of reach; Medium 1% to 5%; Low below 1%. These are team judgements. R&S is rental and services revenue; BoT is the Bank of Thailand.

notes: Backup slide, not presented. The ten risks, ratings, triggers and responses are shortened from Table 6.6; the full wording and sources are in Chapter 6, section 6.3.

facts.on_slide: Risk 1: more than 2 points a year; K4 not above Q1 baseline by Q3
facts.meaning: Online share of Thai retail sales rises by more than 2 points in a year (20.45% to 23.50% over 2022-2024, about 1.5 points a year)

facts.on_slide: Risk 1 response: P1, D4
facts.meaning: Experience-led zones (P1); CENTRAL X as the single front door (D4)
Household debt above 88% of GDP [Proposed]; Bank of Thailand 2027 growth forecast cut below 1.5% [Proposed, 0.6 points under the 2.1% baseline]; R&S growth at or below 4.3% in a quarter

facts.on_slide: Risk 2 response: ladder, R4, CPN already delays some residential launches
facts.meaning: Amber and Red ladder (Table 6.7); capped vouchers (R4); delaying or holding some residential launches, which CPN already does (an existing CPN practice, not a team action)

facts.on_slide: Risk 3: arrivals down over 8%; 4.12% to 17 Oct 2026
facts.meaning: Arrivals down more than 8% year to date; down 4.12% to 17 October 2026

facts.on_slide: Risk 3 response: Line 6 in tranches; India, Gulf, Europe
facts.meaning: Line 6 released in tranches; mix toward India, the Gulf and Europe (M2)
Quarterly mall occupancy below 90%, the K13 measure; 91% in 2Q26

facts.on_slide: Risk 4 response: R1, 2–3% escalators
facts.meaning: Renewal rule R1: escalators inside TRIS's 2% to 3% band, non-rent concessions first
facts.where: ch6.md Table 6.6 row 4, Mitigation; ch4.md row R1

facts.on_slide: Risk 5: ฿720 million; definitive agreement
facts.meaning: International revenue below ฿720 million, 10% under FY2025's ฿800 million; any Vietnam spend before a definitive agreement
facts.cite: Central Pattana Investor Relations, 2026, p. 15; team proposal

facts.on_slide: Risk 5 response: no Vietnam budget; D5 pilot
facts.meaning: No FY2027 marketing budget for Vietnam; Malaysia limited to the D5 pilot

facts.on_slide: Risk 6: 72 hours; 31 Jan 2027
facts.meaning: Any confirmed personal-data breach complaint or leakage incident, or a breach not reported within 72 hours; marketing consent not live by 31 January 2027
facts.cite: Personal Data Protection Act, B.E. 2562, 2019; team proposal

facts.on_slide: Risk 6 response: S1, S4 survey ages 20+ only
facts.meaning: S1 set-up; aggregated extracts only; S4 survey ages 20+ only; count-only counters

facts.on_slide: Risk 7: under 10%; 18% in 2025; under 2.7%
facts.meaning: Carbon-intensity headroom to the bond target path below 10% (18% in 2025, company-reported, finance-report basis); year-to-date free-space share below 2.7%
facts.cite: Central Pattana, n.d.-b, pp. 2, 5; team proposal

facts.on_slide: Risk 7 response: K7; bond never said to fund the ฿110bn plan
facts.meaning: Every claim traced to a CPN document (K7); the bond was issued to support clean-energy projects and is never described as funding the ฿110 billion plan
facts.where: ch6.md Table 6.6 row 7, Mitigation; corrections.md Facts, Residential line

facts.on_slide: Risk 8: over a quarter late; ฿4,149 million; 0.60 times
facts.meaning: FY2027 opening more than one quarter behind CPN's target; annualised finance cost above ฿4,149 million; net debt to equity above 0.60 times

facts.on_slide: Risk 8 response: D1; model rerun
facts.meaning: D1 releases launch spend only after confirmation; model rerun at every release

facts.on_slide: Risk 9: 1.5 points; 3.2 in FY2025
facts.meaning: Reported minus core net margin above 1.5 points (3.2 in FY2025)

facts.on_slide: Risk 9 response: K8; FX gains; CPNREIT sublease
facts.meaning: F1 read on reported and core margin (K8); no plan credit for FX gains or a possible CPNREIT sublease

facts.on_slide: Risk 10: +5% at G3; 3.1 points
facts.meaning: Gen Z visits per active member below +5% at G3 (target +10%); K1 gain (the 20–29 share of visitors aged 20 and over) below the 3.1-point detection limit at the Q4 wave

facts.on_slide: Risk 10 response: P1; CENTRAL X briefs; best format
facts.meaning: Format zones (P1); creator briefs tied to CENTRAL X registration; after S7 move money to the best-performing format within lines 4 and 9
